description: This file defines the 'Stash' class, a client for interacting with the Atlassian Stash (Bitbucket Server) REST API. It includes methods for user authentication, retrieving projects, repositories, repository content, branches, commits, and specific project details.

classes.name: Stash
classes.description: A client class for accessing various endpoints of the Atlassian Stash REST API, including user info, projects, repositories, and commits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Stash client with configuration parameters, sets up the request object, and performs configuration validation.

methods.name: configCheck
methods.description: Validates that essential configuration parameters like host, username, and password are set.

methods.name: testLogin
methods.description: Tests the login credentials by attempting to retrieve the user and checking the request status.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves user information for a given username.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Fetches a list of projects accessible to the user.

methods.name: getRepos
methods.description: Retrieves repositories within a specified project, optionally filtering by repository name.

methods.name: getRepoContent
methods.description: Gets the files and directories within a repository at a specified path, branch, or commit.

methods.name: getBranches
methods.description: Lists branches of a specific repository.

methods.name: getCommits
methods.description: Retrieves commits from a repository, optionally filtered by branch.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific project by its key.
